rows.text: Once all the rage in Amphoreus, this skincare product worked wonders with a simple spray: a veil of golden powder that smoothed wrinkles, brightened, and moisturized the skin. Rumors claimed its essence was drawn from the summit of the Hero's Bath, retrievable only by Chrysos Heir heroes. But as the bath's proprietress grew in divinity, such skincare products vanished completely from the market.
